say:1:1710668001:1.text: Gwyneth! How long will you keep this up? Come back with me! Before the official papers are issued, let's go see the Prince and have you decline this posting.
say:1:1710668001:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝！你还要胡闹到什么时候？立刻跟我回去！趁着文书...

say:2:1710668002:1.text: Tell him you're inexperienced, tell him you're not ready. Any reason! You cannot go!
say:2:1710668002:1.source_cn: 说你能力不足，或者资历太浅——无论什么借口都行，这个先...

say:3:1710668003:1.text: Decline? Tell him I'm not ready? This is the chance I've waited for, Father!
say:3:1710668003:1.source_cn: 请辞？说我能力不足？父亲！这可是我梦寐以求的机会！

say:4:1710668004:1.text: Rather than staying in Savannah as a mere ceremonial guard, I want to be on the front lines, where my strength is needed!
say:4:1710668004:1.source_cn: 比起在赛凡纳当一个仅仅负责巡逻和演武的“花瓶”守备军，...

say:5:1710668005:1.text: Can't you see? I've protected you too much... This isn't an honor, it's a death sentence!
say:5:1710668005:1.source_cn: 你、你看不出来吗？是我一直以来把你保护得太好了……这不...

say:6:1710668006:1.text: The Prince... he wants to send you to the deadliest front alone! He's signing your death warrant!
say:6:1710668006:1.source_cn: 王子他……他是想把你调走，把你一个人扔到最危险的前线！...

say:7:1710668007:1.text: So you still think I'm helpless without your protection, right?
say:7:1710668007:1.source_cn: 陷阱？送死？所以归根结底，您还是觉得——只要离开了您的...

say:9:1710668009:1.text: I'm not a fool, Father. I know the Prince might have his own plans. But so what?
say:9:1710668009:1.source_cn: 我不傻，父亲。我知道王子可能别有用心。但这重要吗？

say:10:1710668010:1.text: You taught me that a knight must be brave and defend the realm! Ashvale County is the front line. That's where I should be!
say:10:1710668010:1.source_cn: 从小您就教导我，骑士应当无畏，应当守护耀光！灰影郡是抗...

say:11:1710668011:1.text: If I can't even face this risk, am I really your daughter?!
say:11:1710668011:1.source_cn: 如果我连这点风险都不敢承担，我还配是您的女儿吗？！

say:12:1710668012:1.text: You oversimplify war! This is a battlefield! Have you heard the sound a man makes when he's dying? Have you smelled a battlefield after the crows have been at it?
say:12:1710668012:1.source_cn: 你把战争想得太简单了！那是战场！你听过数万人在绝望中哭...

say:13:1710668013:1.text: There is no glory there, only death. If you go, you'll die!
say:13:1710668013:1.source_cn: 战场没有荣耀，只有死亡！你现在去，就是去送死！

say:14:1710668014:1.text: And if I don't go, I'll never know what I'm made of! True warriors are forged on the battlefield!
say:14:1710668014:1.source_cn: 如果不去，我又怎么知道自己能不能活下来？！真正的战士只...

say:15:1710668015:1.text: I'm protecting you! When you are truly prepared—
say:15:1710668015:1.source_cn: 我是在保护你！等你真正准备好了——

say:16:1710668016:1.text: I'll never be "truly prepared" in your eyes!
say:16:1710668016:1.source_cn: 等我准备好？在您眼中，我恐怕永远都不可能“真正准备好”。

say:17:1710668017:1.text: Enough! I forbid it. I am your father and your commander. This is an order!
say:17:1710668017:1.source_cn: 够了！我绝不允许你去那种地方！我是你的父亲，也是守备军...

say:18:1710668018:1.text: ... My appointment comes directly from Prince Orion. You are overstepping your authority, Commander.
say:18:1710668018:1.source_cn: ……我的任命是王子殿下亲自下达的。司令阁下，您的命令，...

say:20:1710668019:1.text: With that, Gwyneth turns and leaves. Hendrik looks like he aged by ten years in an instant, his hands dropping helplessly.

say:22:1710668020:1.text: Yikes... humans really know how to make a mess out of caring for each other.
